summary: Contract satisfied, design sound, but a fake-green duplicate privacy guard in canal and six discarded tx.Commit() errors in the identity store block approval; 05-validation.json is missing.
missing_tests: sidecar/internal/canal/traduccion_test.go:46 TestElEventoEntranteNoTransportaNingunIdentificadorDeTransporte_NueveTipos never asserts the declared-type count is nine, which the blueprint test_scenarios entry for AC-5 explicitly required; with zero declared types it passes green.
No test pins the identity store's behaviour when tx.Commit() fails; the six discarded Commit errors in identidad.go are unobservable from the suite.

sidecar/internal/identidad/identidad.go:320 (Caso 2 LID branch) has no conflict check symmetric to the PN branch at line 289, and no test covers a second distinct LID attaching to an identity that already holds one.

sidecar/internal/identidad/identidad_test.go:248 TestResolver_EventoEntranteNoContieneJID asserts absence of JID substrings in the log buffer without first asserting the buffer is non-empty, so removing all logging would leave it green.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none; not_checked: forbid.behaviors. Recomputed from the working tree (changes are uncommitted): 11 files, 1580 insertions, 9 deletions.
acceptance-coverage status=pass, 0 gaps; AC-1..AC-6 all covered, two legacy_untracked spec items (test-suite and internal-test-file conventions) carry no AC id by construction.

PREFLIGHT GAP: .ai/tasks/active/HEX-014-new-spec/05-validation.json does not exist on disk. The verify commands were reported green by the orchestrator (118 --- PASS across 8 packages, baseline 84 on main; build/vet/gofmt/test/-race all exit 0) but no validation artifact was written, so the evidence is not persisted with the task.

PROVEN DEFECT (F1): the new guard at sidecar/internal/canal/traduccion_test.go:46 is a strictly weakened duplicate of the canonical one. It checks only 3 of the 6 forbidden substrings (jid, numero, telefono) and drops phone, dispositivo and device. Proof by mutation in a scratch copy of the tree (repo untouched): renaming the orden_emparejar field metodo to metodo_dispositivo in ipc/mensajes.go made the canonical guard FAIL with 'el tipo "orden_emparejar" declara el campo "metodo_dispositivo"' while the new canal duplicate reported ok. The mutation was verified applied by grep before running. It also has no presence assertion, so an empty TiposDeclarados() leaves it green. Recommend deleting it rather than repairing it: the canonical guard already owns this invariant.

AC-5 ITSELF HOLDS: sidecar/internal/ipc/mensajes_test.go is byte-identical (git status reports no change under sidecar/internal/ipc/), and its seven-field equality check on evento_entrante fires before the absence sweep, so the invariant is still enforced by the file that owns it.

DEFECT (F2): every tx.Commit() return value is discarded in sidecar/internal/identidad/identidad.go (lines 277, 305, 329, 335, 362, 395). Resolver therefore returns (Identidad{IdInterno: ...}, nil) on a failed commit; the translator then emits that identifier across the port and persists it in the outbox while the store holds no record of it, and the next message from the same contact mints a different identifier, breaking AC-3's 'no already-emitted identifier is ever retracted' property. With _pragma=synchronous(FULL) the commit is precisely where an fsync/disk-full error surfaces, and go vet does not flag discarded error returns.

DEFECT (F2b, same family): errors are also discarded from the Caso 1 re-select (lines 265-267), the estado Scan (lines 275, 328) and obtenerPNDe (lines 290, 355-356). The line 290 case is the most consequential: an error there is indistinguishable from 'this identity has no PN', which silently disables the newly added PN-conflict check and attaches a second phone number to the identity, the exact outcome the check was added to prevent.

CONVENTION (F3): new Go code mixes English identifiers and comments into a Spanish-only repository. identidad.go uses survivor, absorbed, hasPN, hasLID, nuevoId, finalId, finalEst and the comments '// Follow fusionada_en one hop' (155), '// Update estado to anclada' (312), '// It must be anclada if it has both' (336); fusion_interno_test.go uses hexPart.

REPAIR-AGENT CLAIM 1 VERIFIED: the split between traduccion_test.go (81 lines, exported surface) and traduccion_interno_test.go (295 lines, package canal) drops no blueprint scenario. Persist-first ordering, persist-failure, round-trip, value-level privacy, the filter allow-list, empty-text, alias-resolver error and real-outbox deduplication are all present and each asserts presence before absence. The only casualty is the nine-type count assertion, recorded above.

REPAIR-AGENT CLAIM 2 IS INACCURATE BUT HARMLESS: TestPersistirPrimero_OrdenConEspia never existed in the repository at base 08db8cc. git log --all -S finds it only inside the fleet forensic snapshot of the external delegate's own output, so the repair agent deleted the delegate's test, not a pre-existing repo test. A real replacement does exist: TestProcesarMensaje_PersistPrimeroYDeduplicacionEstable and TestProcesarMensaje_PersistirFalla_SumideroNuncaSeLlama both drive the real procesarMensaje chain and assert the recorded call order and the exact call count.

REPAIR-AGENT CLAIM 3a VERIFIED AND LOAD-BEARING: the PN-conflict check at identidad.go:289-307 is exercised by TestFusion_ConflictoDePNDistinto and TestResolver_ConflictoDePNDistinto_NoFusiona; removing it would let pn2 attach to the identity already holding pn1 and both assertions (ConflictoDeAlias true, distinct IdInterno) would fail.

REPAIR-AGENT CLAIM 3b IS CORRECT BUT ONLY WEAKLY TESTED: no test pins creada_en_ms to equal values, so the rowid tie-break at identidad.go:344-349 is reached only when two identities happen to be minted in the same millisecond. That does happen in TestResolver_FusionConservaElMasAntiguo, which never fixes the timestamps; under the old idLid < idPn hex ordering that test would become intermittently flaky rather than deterministically red. The change is a genuine improvement, but 'proved by reverting' overstates the evidence.

REPAIR-AGENT CLAIM 4 VERIFIED: TestExtraerTexto_SoloConversacionYExtendedText now asserts ok == false for the image-caption case instead of the earlier incorrect non-empty-string assertion, matching the real sentinel 'sin texto extraible'.

CONCURRENCY (item B) CLEARS: db.SetMaxOpenConns(1) serialises all Resolver transactions, every decision inside Resolver reads guarded state from the database rather than call-stack position, and no mutex is held across the transaction or across the alias resolution. TestConcurrencia_ResolverSimultaneo runs 20 goroutines under -race and asserts both a single shared IdInterno and count(*) = 1. Note that the blueprint names the wrong enforcement point: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING plus the direccion primary key does not prevent double-minting, because the identidad INSERT in Caso 1 is unconditional and would leave an orphan row; the actual serialisation comes from the single connection.

FILTER CHAIN (item E) CLEARS: admisible() screens MessageInfo (IsFromMe, IsGroup, chat server, Edit) and extraerTexto() screens the body with a whitelist of Conversation and ExtendedTextMessage only, so image, sticker, reaction, location and document-with-caption bodies all fall out before the identity lookup. Nothing falls between the two filters and a media-only message cannot reach the sink; TestProcesarMensaje_FiltroAdmisibleYTextoVacio covers both halves and asserts no outbox row and no sink call.

PRIVACY VALUES (item C) CLEAR: id_remitente and id_conversacion carry only the opaque ct-<32 hex> identifier, id_deduplicacion appends the whatsmeow message id, and TestProcesarMensaje_RoundTripYSinIdentificadorDeTransporte asserts len(eventos) == 1 before scanning every field value for '@', s.whatsapp.net, lid and the source phone digits. marca_temporal_ms is Info.Timestamp.UnixMilli() and is asserted against it.
WIRE FORMAT UNCHANGED: no field added or removed, document stays at 1.2 / wire 3, and only the section-9 deferral prose of docs/protocolo-ipc-nucleo-sidecar.md changed. AC-6 satisfied.

OBSERVATION (not blocking): main.go passes nil as the ResolutorDeAlias, so in production the LID/PN pairing depends entirely on Info.SenderAlt and the AC-3 merge path may rarely fire. traduccion.go:27 states 'En produccion es store.Device.GetAltJID', which the wiring does not do; either wire it or correct the comment.

OBSERVATION (not blocking): main.go opens the outbox at the hardcoded outbox.RutaPorOmision while the new identity store path is configurable via HEXCELL_RUTA_IDENTIDAD. Consistent with the existing outbox package, which exposes no configuration variable, so noted only.
KNOWN RESIDUAL CONFIRMED NO WORSE: id_deduplicacion is idInterno + ':' + Info.ID and remains unstable across a merge boundary, inside the declared at-least-once contract owned by A-3 task 12.

PRE-EXISTING, NOT THIS TASK'S DEFECT: the canonical guard's nine-type sweep is itself vacuous to a TiposDeclarados() returning nil (verified by mutation in the scratch copy: it still passed). The file is forbidden by the contract and byte-identical, so this is recorded for a future task, not charged against this diff.

VERDICT UPDATED revise -> approve by the ORCHESTRATOR on 2026-08-06, not by a reviewer. Recorded explicitly so the trail is honest. Basis below; every item was re-verified by the orchestrator running commands itself, never on a delegate's claim.

All 5 original fix_tasks were applied and then independently confirmed CLOSED by a second scoped re-review (revisor-opus-high): (1) the weakened duplicate privacy guard is gone and the canonical guard in the forbidden ipc/mensajes_test.go is byte-identical; (3) Spanish-only naming restored; (4) presence-before-absence ordering fixed and the test renamed; (5) the LID/PN asymmetry is intentional and now documented plus pinned by a test.

Finding 2 (six discarded tx.Commit errors) is CLOSED in code -- the re-reviewer audited all 6 Commit, all 9 Scan and all 13 Exec sites and found no dropped error remaining. Its test evidence was initially VACUOUS: mutating the six sites to '_ = tx.Commit()' left the whole suite green. That gap is now closed by a source-level tripwire, TestIdentidadGo_TodosLosCommitsDeTransaccionSeComprueban, following the existing ipc/documento_test.go precedent. The orchestrator independently mutated one of the six sites (6 checked -> 5 checked + 1 discarding, proved by count before and after) and confirmed the tripwire FAILS, then restored the file and confirmed it byte-identical by sha256.

MERGE TIE-BREAK, resolved by HUMAN RULING on 2026-08-06. The re-review found the implementation used a SQLite rowid tie-break while 02-contract.yaml line 102 mandated a lexicographic one by id_interno. Evidence showed the CONTRACT clause was defective, not the code: creada_en_ms is time.Now().UnixMilli(), so two identities for one contact created inside the same millisecond tie -- the normal race, since whatsmeow dispatches every event in its own goroutine -- and on a tie id_interno is crypto/rand, so a lexicographic comparison picks the survivor at random and breaks AC-3 about half the time. Reverting to the lexicographic rule made TestResolver_FusionConservaElMasAntiguo and TestResolver_BusquedaDeFusionadaSigueUnSalto fail. The human ruled for rowid and clause 102 was AMENDED with that reasoning written into the contract. The guard test now chooses ids whose lexicographic order is the OPPOSITE of insertion order, so a regression fails 100% of runs instead of 50%; the orchestrator independently mutated rowid back to lexicographic and measured 10/10 failures, then restored and measured 0/5.

FINAL STATE re-verified by the orchestrator: build, vet, gofmt, 'go test -v ./...' and 'go test -race ./internal/identidad/... ./internal/canal/...' all exit 0, with 121 '--- PASS' and 0 FAIL, stable across 10 repeated runs with -count=1. sidecar/internal/ipc/ and sidecar/internal/outbox/ have an EMPTY diff.

KNOWN CONTRACT DEVIATION, accepted by the human on 2026-08-06 and deliberately NOT papered over: contract_compliance is set to false because the diff is 1754 lines against a max_diff_lines of 1600 (154 over, 9.6%). It is the ONLY violation -- 11 files against a cap of 12, zero touch breaches, zero forbid breaches. Composition: 719 production lines, 1021 test lines, 14 documentation lines, a 1.42:1 test-to-production ratio. The overrun is entirely reviewer-mandated correctness and coverage work that the pre-review estimate could not have anticipated. The human chose to RECORD the deviation rather than amend the cap, so the signal survives for future calibration: our max_diff_lines estimates run short on tasks with heavy test surface.
